card.name: Not responding to treatment
card.fires_on: The word respond or responsive (sometimes the 'to' after responds) right after 'not' or 'may', in label text about a condition failing to improve with a treatment or measure.

modes.label: Not respond / not responsive
modes.description: A symptom or condition that does not respond to a therapy, fluids, or supportive care.
modes.example: In the event that vasopressors are considered for the management of severe hypotension which does not<< respond>> to intravenous fluids and repositioning

modes.label: May respond / responds to
modes.description: A tumor or disease that may respond to a therapy, with the marked word being respond or the 'to' after responds.
modes.example: Lymphosarcomas in Stage III may<< respond>> to combined drug therapy with methotrex

card.plain: It lights up on the word 'respond' when the text says a problem does or does not respond to treatment.
